description: For each file path in an input list, reads file content, generates a 12-byte nonce via RAND_bytes(), encrypts using AES-256-GCM via EVP_CIPHER_CTX (key passed as const uint8_t*), produces ciphertext and 16-byte GCM tag. Writes a new file with original path appended with ".PROCESSED" containing [12-byte nonce][ciphertext][16-byte GCM tag]. Overwrites original file with zeros via fwrite then removes it with remove(). Returns nothing.
name: transform_files
